content: «Dendada he gita katamaa Nannawe baada tani nees yootiza qaalaa isttas awajja» gishe yides.
Histtiin Yoonaasi dendidi GODAA qaalaaththo Nannawe bides. Nannawey keehi gita katama; ha gaxappe he gaxa gakkanaas heedzdzu gallas hemeththees.
Yoonaasi Nannawe katama bi gakkidi issi gallassa oge mala katamaas giddo biidi, «Oyddu tammu
gallassafe guye Nannawey dhayana» giidi awajjides.
Histtiin Nannawe asay Xoossaa ammanidi xooma awajjides; gitatappe guuththata gakkanaas wurikka maaqa may7ida.
Yo7ozi Nannawe kawookko gakkiin izi ba kawoteththaa araataappe wodhdhidi kawoteththaa may7o may7idayssa qaaridi maaqa may7idi bidinththan uttides.
Histtidi Nannawe asaas, «Kawozappenne kawo oosanchchatappe imettida azazo mala hachchife doommidi asinne mehey ubbay aykkoka mooppo; haaththika uyoppo.
Asaykka meheykka wuri maaqa may7o; asi wuri minththidi Xoossako waasso; ba iita ogeppenne qoho oosoppeka simmo.
Histtiko Xoossay nuus qadhettidi nu dhayontta mala ba wolqqama hanqofe simmanaakko oonee erizay» gides.
Istti ba iita ogeppe simmidayssa Xoossay be7idi isttas qadhettidi istta bolla ehana gida pirdaa aggides.

footnotes.text: Oyddu tammu gizayssa laappun tammu eranchchata birsheththan heedzdzu gallas gees.
